name: tandem
description: Use Claude Code as a model in the Codex desktop app, with Codex running its commands and edits.

interface.shortDescription: Claude Code in the Codex model picker.
interface.longDescription: Adds Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) next to your GPT models. Claude Code runs the agent loop, reading, search, skills and subagents with your own Claude login; Codex executes its shell commands and file edits with normal approvals and shows them as native command and diff cards. GPT keeps its default, login and traffic.
defaultPrompt: Enable Tandem so I can pick Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) in the model picker
